title: Atesen Company and Jobs Data
instructions: French company registry data, US SEC filings, trademark phrase checks, website contacts and public job postings. Each tool runs a public Apify Actor on the caller's own Apify account (APIFY_TOKEN). Start with a small result limit; Apify bills per result.

tools.name: french_company_enrichment_sirene
tools.title: French Company SIRENE API
tools.description: Look up French company data by business identifiers using SIRENE. Runs the public Apify Actor atesen-software/french-company-enrichment-sirene on YOUR Apify account; Apify bills up to $0.004 per result (pay-per-event). Set a small result limit first.

mode.description: Lookup existing identifiers/names, or discover companies with activity and geographic filters.

identifiers.description: One per line. 9-digit SIREN, 14-digit SIRET or French VAT number (FR + 11 characters). Spaces, dots and dashes are ignored. Use 'Bulk edit' to paste a whole column from Excel or Google Sheets.

csvText.description: Lookup mode only. Paste only identifier columns with siren and/or siret headers. Comma or semicolon separated; keep IDs as literal digits, including leading zeros. No file uploads or URLs. Maximum 1 MiB UTF-8, 1,000 data records and 1,000 combined input items including blank cells. Other columns are rejected. Input is

companyNames.description: One company name per line. Optionally add a postal code or department after a vertical bar to narrow the search, e.g. 'Decathlon | 59' or 'Boulangeries Paul | 59700'. Each row gets a match confidence score.

minConfidence.description: Name matches below this score are returned as 'low_confidence' with the candidate SIRENs listed, and are not charged. Lower it to accept fuzzier matches.

onlyActiveCompanies.description: Name matching and search mode: return active legal units only. Does not filter exact identifier lookups or guarantee each branch is open.

includeFinances.description: Latest published revenue (chiffre d'affaires) and net income, when the company filed public accounts. Many small companies have none.

includeDirectors.description: Adds company officers from the national business register (RNE). This is personal data: only enable it if you have a lawful basis under GDPR. Birth dates and nationalities are never output.

validateOnly.description: Checks every identifier (check digits, VAT key), removes duplicates and shows what would be looked up — without calling the registry and without any charge.

checkVat.description: Check each company's intra-EU VAT number against the European Commission VIES service. Adds vatValid, vatViesName, vatViesAddress, vatCheckedAt and vatCheckError. Free add-on; slower (about 2 checks per second).

checkBodacc.description: Look up insolvency notices (procédures collectives: redressement judiciaire, liquidation judiciaire, sauvegarde) published in the BODACC for each company. Adds bodaccHasProceedings, bodaccProcedure, bodaccJudgment, bodaccJudgmentDate, bodaccPublicationDate, bodaccTribunal, bodaccUrl and bodaccNoticesCount. Free add-on.

maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Upper bound for calls to the government API (its official limit is 7/s per IP, and it throttles harder under load). The Actor slows down automatically when throttled; you rarely need to change this.

searchQuery.description: Optional company name in search mode. Use identifiers for numeric SIREN/SIRET lookups.

nafCode.description: Search mode: exact legal-unit activity code, for example 62.01Z. This filters the company activity, not each branch activity.

region.description: Search mode: two-digit INSEE region, for example 11 (Ile-de-France). Matches establishments; company output may have its head office elsewhere.

department.description: Search mode: department such as 75, 59, 2A or 971.

postalCode.description: Search mode: exact five-digit establishment postal code.

outputMode.description: Search mode: one row per company head office, or one per matching establishment with isHeadOffice and headOfficeSiret. API search windows apply.

maxResults.description: Search mode: maximum delivered rows. Lower this for a small first run. Also bounded by the run spending limit.

tools.name: french_company_financials_ratios
tools.title: French Company Financials API
tools.description: Retrieve French company financial statements and ratios by SIREN. Runs the public Apify Actor atesen-software/french-company-financials-ratios on YOUR Apify account; Apify bills up to $0.01 per result (pay-per-event). Set a small result limit first.

sirens.description: One per line. 9-digit SIREN, 14-digit SIRET (first 9 digits are used) or French VAT number (FRxx + SIREN). Spaces and dots are ignored. Use 'Bulk edit' to paste a whole column.

years.description: Only return accounts whose fiscal year ends in these years, e.g. 2023, 2024. Leave empty for every year available.

latestYearOnly.description: Return only the most recent filed year per company (one or two rows: corporate and, if any, consolidated accounts).

accountsTypes.description: C = complete corporate accounts, S = simplified corporate accounts (small companies), K = consolidated group accounts.

includeCompanyIdentity.description: Looks up each SIREN in the official Recherche d'entreprises API (free) to add the legal name, NAF code, size category and head-office city.

maxCompanies.description: Stop after this many valid SIRENs. Useful for a quick test.

tools.name: french_website_siren_mentions_legales
tools.title: French Website SIREN API
tools.description: Find French business identifiers in website legal notices. Runs the public Apify Actor atesen-software/french-website-siren-mentions-legales on YOUR Apify account; Apify bills up to $0.005 per result (pay-per-event). Set a small result limit first.

websites.description: One per line: a domain (pennylane.com), a URL (https://www.payfit.com/fr/) or a sub-site. Duplicates are removed. Use 'Bulk edit' to paste a whole column.

enrichWithSirene.description: Verify each SIREN found against the official Recherche d'entreprises API (INSEE SIRENE + RNE) and add the registered legal name, address, NAF code, headcount range, size category, latest revenue and the computed VAT number.

maxPagesPerSite.description: Homepage + the most likely legal pages (mentions légales, informations légales, CGV, à propos, contact). The crawl stops early as soon as a legal page with a SIREN is found.

maxConcurrency.description: How many websites are processed at the same time. Each website is crawled politely, one page per second.

respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip pages that the website's robots.txt disallows.

tools.name: sec_edgar_company_data
tools.title: SEC EDGAR Company Data API
tools.description: Retrieve official SEC filing metadata and selected US-GAAP fact observations for a company by CIK or ticker. The request supplies a User-Agent with an organization name and contact email for the SEC. Each saved result is charged by the Actor; status and error rows are free. Runs the public Apify Actor atesen-software/sec-edgar-company-data on YOUR Apify account; Apify bills up to $0.0015 per result (pay-per-event). Set a small result limit first.

cik.description: 1–10 digits, optional CIK prefix. Supply exactly one of cik or ticker.

ticker.description: Resolved using SEC company_tickers.json. Omit when supplying cik.

userAgent.description: Required organization name and actual contact email. Sent to SEC only, never included in result rows. Example: Your Organization your-real-contact@your-domain.tld

forms.description: Exact SEC form names, such as 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K. Empty means all. Applies to filings and facts.

startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD filing date, for filings and facts.

endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD filing date, for filings and facts.

includeFilings.description: Return one metadata row per accession number.

includeOlderFilings.description: Read SEC historical pages only when recent filings do not fill the limit.

maxOlderPages.description: Bound archive downloads, in addition to the recent submissions request.

includeFacts.description: Read selected companyfacts observations. One row per concept/unit/period/accession/value.

concepts.description: Case-sensitive concept names without namespace, maximum 20.

yearlyOnly.description: FY observations in annual forms; duration facts must cover at least 300 days. Instant facts retained.

maxFacts.description: Newest filed observations across selected concepts; maximum 1000.

tools.name: trademark_phrase_risk_check
tools.title: USPTO Trademark Phrase Check API
tools.description: Check slogans and brand ideas against live USPTO trademarks. Returns a clear, low, medium or high risk verdict per phrase with the conflicting marks, classes and status. Screening aid, not legal advice. Each checked phrase is charged by the Actor; phrases that could not be checked are free. Runs the public Apify Actor atesen-software/trademark-phrase-risk-check on YOUR Apify account; Apify bills up to $0.05 per result (pay-per-event). Set a small result limit first.

phrases.description: Slogans, product names or brand ideas, one per line, up to 1,000 per run. Example: Cat Dad, Just do it, Mama Bear. Duplicates are checked once.

classes.description: USPTO international classes your product falls into. A live exact match in one of these classes is rated high risk; the same match in another class is rated medium. Leave empty to treat every class the same. Class 25 is clothing, 21 mugs and housewares, 9 phone cases, 16 posters and stickers, 18 bags, 20 pillows and fu

matchMode.description: Exact and similar also looks for near spellings and marks with the same words (one extra search per phrase). Exact checks the phrase itself only.

includeDead.description: Also list abandoned and cancelled marks. They never raise the verdict above low.

maxMatchesPerPhrase.description: How many conflicting marks to list for each phrase, most serious first.

includeIndividualOwners.description: Off by default: when the owner is a private person, the name is withheld and only the owner type is shown. Company names are always shown.

tools.name: website_email_contact_finder
tools.title: Website Contact Finder API
tools.description: Extract published business contact details from websites. Runs the public Apify Actor atesen-software/website-email-contact-finder on YOUR Apify account; Apify bills up to $0.005 per result (pay-per-event). Set a small result limit first.

websites.description: Domains or URLs of the companies, one per line ("acme.com", "https://www.acme.de/kontakt"). Each website is crawled once: duplicates are skipped and not charged.

startUrls.description: Same as Websites, in the request-list format used by other contact scrapers, so you can reuse existing inputs.

datasetUrlField.description: Field that contains the website, if it is not website / url / domain.

maxPagesPerSite.description: Home page plus the best contact, imprint, about and legal pages (detected in 15+ languages). 6 is enough for most companies. The price is per website, not per page.

maxSites.description: Stop after this many websites (0 = no limit). Useful for a quick test on a big dataset.

verifyEmailDomains.description: Drop emails whose domain cannot receive mail (no MX/A record). Removes typos and fake addresses.

onlySameDomainEmails.description: Keep only emails like info@acme.com for acme.com (drops gmail.com, agency and partner addresses).

includePhonesFromText.description: Besides tel: links and structured data, also return numbers written in the page text (validated with libphonenumber). Each phone in phoneDetails shows its source.

maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to crawl at the same time.

tools.name: career_site_jobs_api
tools.title: Career Site Jobs API
tools.description: Retrieve job postings from public company career sites and ATS boards. Runs the public Apify Actor atesen-software/career-site-jobs-api on YOUR Apify account; Apify bills up to $0.005 per result (pay-per-event). Set a small result limit first.

companies.description: One per line. Any of: a company website ("stripe.com"), a careers page URL, a job board URL ("https://jobs.lever.co/palantir", "https://boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb", "https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite"), an explicit "ats:board" pair ("ashby:notion", "workable:huggingface", "smartrecruiters:B

startUrls.description: Same as Companies, in request-list format, if you already have URL lists from other actors.

keywords.description: Only jobs whose title contains at least one of these words (case-insensitive), e.g. "engineer", "data", "sales". Empty = all jobs.

excludeKeywords.description: Skip jobs whose title contains any of these words, e.g. "intern", "senior".

locations.description: Only jobs whose location contains one of these texts, e.g. "London", "Berlin", "remote".

countries.description: Only jobs in these countries: ISO codes or names ("US", "DE", "United Kingdom").

workplaceTypes.description: Only these workplace types. Jobs whose workplace type is not published (and not stated in the title or location) are excluded when this filter is set.

employmentTypes.description: Only these (normalised) employment types. Jobs without a published employment type are excluded when this filter is set.

departments.description: Only jobs whose department or team contains one of these texts, e.g. "Engineering".

postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days (0 = any date).

descriptionFormat.description: Plain text (default), HTML, both, or none (faster, smaller output; SmartRecruiters and Workday then need no extra requests).

dedupeSimilarJobs.description: Some companies post the same job several times (same title and location). Keep only one.

maxJobs.description: Stop after this many jobs (0 = no limit).

tools.name: workday_jobs_scraper
tools.title: Workday Jobs API
tools.description: Retrieve job postings from public Workday career boards. Runs the public Apify Actor atesen-software/workday-jobs-scraper on YOUR Apify account; Apify bills up to $0.001 per result (pay-per-event). Set a small result limit first.

companies.description: One per line. Any of: a Workday career site URL ("https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite"), "workday:intel" (the career site is found automatically), a company website or careers page that links to Workday ("adobe.com"), or a company name.
